purpose: Define the intended ownership split between sanida-dados-fiscais and a future calculator frontend repository without moving files yet.

split_before_move.reason: H26 currently combines DOM/UI adaptation with fiscal assessment orchestration. Before repository extraction, pure fiscal calculation/orchestration must be isolated from presentation so only the UI adapter moves.
The current smoke covers both fiscal integration and page behavior. Split into fiscal contract integration tests and frontend browser/visual tests before extraction.
The current deployment inventory combines fiscal/plugin/runtime files with public frontend pages. Future deployment ownership must be separated without rewriting historical evidence.

requirements: frontend must fail closed when the required fiscal release cannot be validated
frontend must not duplicate fiscal formulas in presentation code
frontend deploy must not mutate fiscal releases or backend rules
fiscal deploy must not mutate visual templates or CSS
cross-repository compatibility must be validated before production

migration_rule: No file is moved solely because its current path contains consumers/frontend; ownership follows responsibility, not directory name.
